descriptionHtml:
思路 / Approach · EFS Empty & Failure States · S11 「两个模式下拍照录入：照片上没有病人，以及文件看不清：明确的提示，什么都不加」 Photo capture with no patients on it and with an unreadable file, in both contexts: explicit message, nothing added

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U7 Photo capture found no patients, or the photo is unreadable: an explicit message, and nothing is added.（UAT EFS state 7；TFA-94745 state 7）
  • U11 Every state shows a clear, plain-language message in the app's existing style that tells the physician what to do next (retry, enable permission, sign in, check connection).（UAT EFS Expected Result；TFA-94745 AC 1；TFA-94745 AC 5）
  • U12 No state ever shows a blank screen, a crash, a raw error pop-up, or invented content.（UAT EFS intro；UAT 3.4；TFA-94745 AC 2）
  • U14 Every state works in both Hospital and Nursing Home, on web, iOS and Android.（UAT EFS Expected Result；UAT 3.3；TFA-94745 AC 6）

测试设计方法：等价类（equivalence） — 同一条规则换一类输入（医院 / 养老院、另一种数据）再验一次，每一类都要对。

Given Standard fixture (one patient, one resident); two synthetic images: a photo of a cafeteria menu (no names) and a corrupt .jpg of random bytes

When Open the Hospital scan control and pick the menu photo; then the corrupt file; close the scan; repeat with the Nursing Home resident-list scan

Then The menu photo ends with a message that no patients / residents were found; the corrupt file ends with a message that the photo couldn't be read; each says what to do (clearer photo, retake, try again); no row is offered for import; the lists still hold only the fixture patient and resident

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：From U7: menu-photo checkpoints mustContain 'no patients found' (Hospital) / 'no residents found' (Nursing Home), corrupt-file checkpoints mustContain 'be read', each with a next-step group, and all mustNotContain the menu items; list checkpoints mustContain the fixture name and mustNotContain the menu items; post-run backend read: exactly 1 Hospital patient and 1 resident. …

在哪跑：dev；测试方法 AGENT · 浏览器 agent；矩阵里排的车道 浏览器 agent（blocked）

S11 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/EFS.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。
